partners.mechanism_chain: SOX3 (HGNC:11116) —LEADS_TO→ Pituitary hormone deficiency (HP:0000825); Pituitary hormone deficiency (HP:0000825) —LEADS_TO→ Panhypopituitarism (MONDO:0010712); APC (HGNC:537) —DISRUPTS→ Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP1788); Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP1788) —LEADS_TO→ Gastrointestinal polyps (HP:0030175); Gastrointestinal polyps (HP:0030175) —LEADS_TO→ Gastric Adenocarcinoma and Proximal Polyposis of the Stomach (MONDO:0017790).
